{{nihongo|'''Nakayama Shrine'''|中山神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

{{wikidata link|Q11364249|ja|中山神社 (美濃加茂市)|grok=none|check_date=2026-06-03}}

'''Nakayama Shrine''' (????????) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}{{ill|Minokamo, Gifu|ar|مينوكامو غيفو|azb|مینوکامو، قیفو|ce|Минокамо|ceb|Minokamo|de|Minokamo|es|Minokamo|fa|مینوکامو، گیفو|fi|Mino-Kamo|fr|Minokamo|gl|Minokamo|it|Minokamo|ja|美濃加茂市|ko|미노카모시|mg|Minokamo|mzn|مینوکامو، گیفو|nl|Minokamo|pl|Minokamo|pt|Minokamo|ro|Minokamo|ru|Минокамо|su|Minokamo, Gifu|sv|Minokamo|tg|Минокамо|tl|Minokamo, Gifu|tr|Minokamo|tt|Минокамо|uk|Міно-Камо|ur|مینوکامو، گیفو|vi|Minokamo, Gifu|war|Minokamo, Gifu|zh|美濃加茂市|zh_classical|美濃加茂市|zh_min_nan|Minokamo-chhī|zh_yue|美濃加茂|qid=Q857305}}.

It is a candidate shrine for Nakayama Shrine of the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha}} in {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156}}{{ill|Kamo District, Gifu|ceb|Kamo-gun (distrito sa Hapon, Gifu-ken)|es|Distrito de Kamo (Gifu)|fr|District de Kamo (Gifu)|id|Distrik Kamo, Gifu|it|Distretto di Kamo (Gifu)|ja|加茂郡|ko|가모군 (기후현)|pl|Powiat Kamo|pt|Distrito de Kamo|th|อำเภอคาโมะ|uk|Повіт Камо (Ґіфу)|vi|Kamo (quận)|zh|加茂郡|qid=Q1348656|lt=Kamo District}} (the other candidate shrine is {{ill|Suwa Shrine (Q11631934)|ja|諏訪神社 (美濃加茂市)|qid=Q11631934|lt=Suwa Shrine}}).

=== History ===
Its founding date is unknown. It was destroyed by fire in wartime during the {{ill|Eiroku|ca|Eiroku|ckb|ئێیرۆکو|fa|ایروکو|fr|Ère Eiroku|ja|永禄|ko|에이로쿠|ru|Эйроку|simple|Eiroku|sr|Еироку|sv|Eiroku|tr|Eiroku|zh|永祿|qid=Q1143341}} era, and no records remain from before that.

It was rebuilt in Eiroku 12 ({{ill|1569|ab|1569|af|1569|als|1569|am|1569 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1569|ar|1569|ary|1569|arz|1569|ast|1569|avk|1569|az|1569|azb|۱۵۶۹ (میلادی)|bar|1569|bat_smg|1569|bcl|1569|be|1569|be_x_old|1569|bg|1569|bn|১৫৬৯|bpy|মারি ১৫৬৯|br|1569|bs|1569.|ca|1569|cdo|1569 nièng|ceb|1569|ckb|١٥٦٩|crh|1569|cs|1569|cv|1569|cy|1569|da|1569|de|1569|diq|1569|el|1569|eml|1569|eo|1569|es|1569|et|1569|eu|1569|fa|۱۵۶۹ (میلادی)|fi|1569|fo|1569|fr|1569|frr|1569|fur|1569|fy|1569|ga|1569|gan|1569年|gcr|1569|gd|1569|gl|1569|gv|1569|he|1569|hi|१५६९|hif|1569|hr|1569.|ht|1569 (almanak jilyen)|hu|1569|hy|1569|hyw|1569 թուական|ia|1569|id|1569|ilo|1569|io|1569|is|1569|it|1569|ja|1569年|jv|1569|ka|1569|kaa|1569|kk|1569 жыл|ko|1569년|krc|1569 джыл|la|1569|lb|1569|lij|1569|lmo|1569|lo|ຄ.ສ. 1569|lt|1569 m.|lv|1569. gads|mai|१५६९|map_bms|1569|mdf|1569|mg|1569|mhr|1569|mi|1569|min|1569|mk|1569|mn|1569 он|mr|इ.स. १५६९|mrj|1569 и|ms|1569|my|၁၅၆၉|myv|1569 ие|mzn|۱۵۶۹|nah|1569|nap|1569|nds|1569|new|सन् १५६९|nl|1569|nn|1569|no|1569|nrm|1569|nso|1569|oc|1569|or|୧୫୬୯|os|1569-æм аз|pl|1569|pnb|1569|pt|1569|qu|1569|ro|1569|ru|1569 год|rue|1569|sa|१५६९|sah|1569|scn|1569|sd|1569ع|se|1569|sh|1569.|shn|1569|simple|1569|sk|1569|sl|1569|smn|1569|sq|1569|sr|1569|su|1569|sv|1569|sw|1569|ta|1569|te|1569|tg|Соли 1569|th|พ.ศ. 2112|tk|1569|tl|1569|tly|1569|tr|1569|tt|1569 ел|uk|1569|ur|1569ء|uz|1569|vec|1569|vi|1569|vls|1569|wa|1569|war|1569|wuu|1569年|xmf|1569|yi|1569|zh|1569年|zh_min_nan|1569 nî|zh_yue|1569年|qid=Q6653}}). After that, records of shrine construction and rebuilding exist for the {{ill|Keichō|Q1328185|qid=Q1328185}}, {{ill|Kan'ei|Q1192913|qid=Q1192913}}, and {{ill|Enpō|Q1145735|qid=Q1145735}} eras.

It is said that {{ill|Suwa Shrine (Q11631934)|ja|諏訪神社 (美濃加茂市)|qid=Q11631934|lt=Suwa Shrine}} moved and rebuilt Nakayama Shrine by order of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kota Genryu}}, lord of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yoneda Castle}}, then enshrined {{ill|Suwa-taisha|abstract|Q218813|de|Suwa-Taisha|es|Suwa taisha|eu|Suwa taisha|fa|زیارتگاه بزرگ سووا|fr|Suwa-taisha|hu|Szuva templom|id|Kuil Suwa|it|Santuario di Suwa (Sohonsha)|ja|諏訪大社|ko|스와 대사|lt|Suvos maldykla|pl|Suwa Taisha|ru|Сува-тайся|simple|Suwa-taisha|tr|Suwa-taisha|zh|諏訪大社|qid=Q218813}} of {{ill|Shinano Province|Q289250|qid=Q289250}} and renamed it Suwa Shrine. The current Nakayama Shrine is thought to be a shrine rebuilt at the original location.
